purpose: 20 representative queries used to baseline chat-ai latency. 4 per model_type. Submit each at least once on staging/prod after the perf instrumentation is deployed.
instructions: For each entry, create a fresh conversation in the matching plan, send the question text via the normal chat UI (not the edge function directly), then wait for the response. Repeat the full set 3 times to get a usable sample (~60 rows in chat_perf_metrics).
